tests.title: Landing page renders correctly
tests.description: Verify the landing page loads with hero section, features, and CTA buttons
tests.expectedResult: Landing page renders with hero content and CTA buttons

tests.title: Demo CTA navigates to dashboard
tests.description: Clicking the demo CTA button navigates to the app dashboard
tests.expectedResult: User is redirected to /app/dashboard

tests.title: Navigation links scroll to sections
tests.description: Header nav links scroll to the corresponding page sections
steps: Verify features section is in viewport
tests.expectedResult: Page scrolls to the targeted section

tests.title: Dashboard renders metric cards
tests.description: Dashboard page loads and displays summary metric cards with inventory stats
steps: Check for metric cards (Total Items, In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock)
tests.expectedResult: Four metric cards are visible with numeric values

tests.title: Needs Attention section shows alerts
tests.description: Dashboard displays items needing attention such as low stock or overdue POs
tests.expectedResult: Needs Attention section is visible with actionable alert items

tests.title: Recent Activity loads entries
tests.description: Dashboard shows recent activity feed with movement and order entries
tests.expectedResult: Recent activity entries are displayed with timestamps

tests.title: Sidebar navigation works
tests.description: Clicking sidebar links navigates to the correct pages
tests.expectedResult: Navigation changes to the clicked page

tests.title: Catalog table renders items
tests.description: Catalog page loads and displays inventory items in a table
steps: Verify rows contain item names and SKUs
tests.expectedResult: Table renders with seed data items

tests.title: Create new item via form
tests.description: Open the item form, fill in required fields, and save a new item
steps: Fill name, SKU, and stock fields
tests.expectedResult: New item appears in the catalog table with a success toast

tests.title: Edit existing item
tests.description: Open an existing item, modify a field, and save changes
steps: Click on an item row to open detail
tests.expectedResult: Item is updated and the new name is reflected in the table

tests.title: Delete item with confirmation
tests.description: Delete an item and confirm via the alert dialog
tests.expectedResult: Item is removed from the table with a success toast

tests.title: Filter and search items
tests.description: Use the search bar and category filter to narrow down items
steps: Type a search term in the search input
Verify table filters to matching items
tests.expectedResult: Table shows only items matching the search and filter criteria

tests.title: Bulk select and actions
tests.description: Select multiple items and perform a bulk action
steps: Perform a bulk action (e.g., change category)
tests.expectedResult: Bulk action bar appears and selected items are updated

tests.title: Suppliers table renders
tests.description: Suppliers page loads and displays supplier list
steps: Check table is visible with supplier names
tests.expectedResult: Supplier table renders with seed data

tests.title: Create new supplier
tests.description: Open supplier form, fill fields, and save
tests.expectedResult: New supplier appears in the table with a success toast

tests.title: Edit existing supplier
tests.description: Open a supplier detail, modify fields, and save
tests.expectedResult: Supplier is updated with new values

tests.title: Delete supplier with linked-item guard
tests.description: Attempt to delete a supplier that has linked items or open POs
steps: Find a supplier with linked items
tests.expectedResult: Deletion is blocked with a toast explaining linked items/POs exist

tests.title: PO table renders with summary stats
tests.description: Purchase orders page loads with summary stats and table
steps: Check summary stat cards are visible
tests.expectedResult: Summary stats and PO table render with seed data

tests.title: Create purchase order with line items
tests.description: Create a new PO, add line items, and save
tests.expectedResult: New PO appears in the table with Draft status and success toast

tests.title: Edit purchase order
tests.description: Open an existing PO, modify notes or line items, and save
steps: Click a PO row to open detail
tests.expectedResult: PO is updated with new values

tests.title: Receive shipment flow
tests.description: Receive items against a submitted PO and verify stock updates
tests.expectedResult: PO status updates to Received/Partial, item stock increases, movements are created

tests.title: Delete purchase order
tests.description: Delete a draft purchase order
tests.expectedResult: PO is removed from the table with success toast

tests.title: Requests table renders
tests.description: Requests page loads and displays request list
steps: Check table is visible with request entries
tests.expectedResult: Request table renders with seed data

tests.title: Create new request
tests.description: Submit a new inventory request with items
tests.expectedResult: New request appears in table with Pending status

tests.title: Approve request
tests.description: Approve a pending inventory request as admin/manager
tests.expectedResult: Request status changes to Approved with success toast

tests.title: Decline request with reason
tests.description: Decline a pending request and provide a decline reason
tests.expectedResult: Request status changes to Declined with the provided reason

tests.title: Movements table renders
tests.description: Movements page loads and displays movement history
steps: Check table is visible with movement entries
tests.expectedResult: Movements table renders with seed data

tests.title: Record new movement
tests.description: Record a stock-in or adjustment movement
tests.expectedResult: New movement appears in table and item stock is updated

tests.title: Filter movements by type and date
tests.description: Use filters to narrow movements by type or date range
tests.expectedResult: Table shows only movements matching the selected filter

tests.title: Location tree renders
tests.description: Locations page loads and displays the hierarchical location tree
steps: Check tree structure is visible with warehouses and sub-locations
tests.expectedResult: Location tree renders with seed data hierarchy

tests.title: Create new location
tests.description: Add a new location to the tree
tests.expectedResult: New location appears in the tree with success toast

tests.title: Transfer stock between locations
tests.description: Transfer an item's stock from one location to another
tests.expectedResult: Transfer movement is created and item location is updated

tests.title: Admin can access settings page
tests.description: Verify admin role can navigate to and view settings
tests.expectedResult: Settings page renders with all tabs accessible

tests.title: Manage categories in settings
tests.description: Add, rename, and delete categories from the settings page
tests.expectedResult: Category is created, renamed, and deleted with toast feedback

tests.title: Reset demo data
tests.description: Reset all demo data from the system settings tab
tests.expectedResult: All data is reset to seed defaults with confirmation toast

tests.title: Sidebar links navigate correctly
tests.description: Each sidebar link navigates to the correct page
steps: Verify URL matches expected route for each
tests.expectedResult: All sidebar links navigate to their respective pages

tests.title: Command palette opens with Cmd+K
tests.description: Keyboard shortcut opens the command palette
tests.expectedResult: Command palette opens and shows searchable items, pages, and actions

tests.title: Mobile bottom nav works
tests.description: On mobile viewport, bottom navigation bar is visible and functional
tests.expectedResult: Bottom nav is visible on mobile and navigates correctly

tests.title: Stock analytics page renders charts
tests.description: Analytics page loads with stock-related charts and summary cards
steps: Verify at least one chart (e.g., Stock by Category) renders
tests.expectedResult: Analytics page displays summary cards and chart visualizations

tests.title: Supplier and cost analytics render
tests.description: Analytics page shows supplier performance and cost analysis sections
steps: Verify charts and score cards are visible
tests.expectedResult: Supplier score cards and cost trend charts are displayed
